description_en: Retrieves the log collection configuration of an edge container application
description_zh: 获取边缘容器应用日志采集配置
name: GetEdgeContainerAppLogRiver

parameters.help_en:
The application ID. You can call the [ListEdgeContainerApps](~~ListEdgeContainerApps~~) operation to obtain the application ID.
<notice>AppId is a required parameter. If this parameter is not specified, the API returns InvalidParameter.appid (400). You can call the ListEdgeContainerApps operation to obtain a valid AppId.</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
应用ID，可使用[ListEdgeContainerApps](~~ListEdgeContainerApps~~)接口获取应用ID。
<notice>AppId 为实际必填参数，未提供时 API 返回 InvalidParameter.appid (400)；可通过 ListEdgeContainerApps 接口获取有效的 AppId。</notice>
parameters.name: app_id

Path.description_en: The log file path of the container. The path must be an absolute path that starts with a forward slash (/). Asterisks (*) and question marks (?) can be used as wildcards
Path.description_zh: 容器的日志文件路径，必须为绝对路径，以“/”开头；支持使用星号（*）和半角问号（?）通配符

Stdout.description_en: Indicates whether standard output collection is enabled for the container
Stdout.description_zh: 开启容器的标准输出采集
